app.name: Masarat
app.tagline: Electronic manifest and transport tax system

owner.title: Fleet Owner Portal
owner.subtitle: Register trips, pay transport tax and receive authorized manifests.

govt.title: Government Portal
govt.subtitle: Monitor transport manifests and tax collection.

fields.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
fields.tinHint: Your company's TIN as registered with the Taxation Chamber.

errors.missing_fields: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.invalid_username: Usernames must be 3 to 32 characters using lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
errors.wrong_panel: This account belongs to the other panel. Switch panels to log in.
errors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Please try again.
errors.invalid_tin: The TIN can be at most 30 characters.
errors.address_too_long: The address can be at most 200 characters.
errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

button.unsupported: Updates work in the installed app only

dialog.title: Update ready
dialog.body: Version {{version}} has been downloaded. Restart Masarat to finish installing it.
dialog.bodyNoVersion: A new version has been downloaded. Restart Masarat to finish installing it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your account and company details.
profile.companyHint: The company or transport office name printed on your manifests.
profile.carrierNote: The company name, address and TIN are printed on your manifests as the carrier. The address and TIN are needed before you can generate a bill ID.

fleet.title: Vehicles
fleet.subtitle: Register the vehicles in your fleet, with their registration number, type and carrying capacity.

empty.title: No vehicles yet
empty.body: Add your first vehicle to start registering trips and paying transport tax.

dialog.subtitle: Plate, registration number, type and carrying capacity.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this vehicle?
deleteDialog.body: The vehicle will be removed from your fleet. This cannot be undone.

fields.plateHint: Choose the state letters, then enter the series (1–99) and the number (1–99999).
fields.registrationNoHint: As written on the vehicle's registration (licence) document.

errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.missing_fields: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.invalid_plate: Enter a valid plate: state letters, a series from 1 to 99 and a number from 1 to 99999.
errors.invalid_capacity: Capacity must be greater than zero.
errors.plate_taken: A vehicle with this plate number is already registered.
errors.vehicle_not_found: This vehicle could not be found.
errors.vehicle_in_use: Vehicles with registered trips can't be deleted.
errors.unit_in_use: The unit can't be changed because this vehicle already has trips recorded in its current unit.
errors.city_not_found: Choose a valid origin and destination.
errors.same_route: Origin and destination must be different cities.
errors.invalid_quantity: Cargo quantity must be greater than zero.
errors.unit_mismatch: This vehicle can't carry the selected cargo type.
errors.over_capacity: Cargo quantity exceeds the vehicle's capacity.
errors.manifest_not_found: This trip could not be found.
errors.already_billed: A bill has already been issued for this trip.
errors.not_billed: Generate a bill ID for this trip first.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_items: Every cargo item needs a name and a quantity greater than zero.
errors.not_draft: This trip's bill ID has been generated, so it can no longer be edited.
errors.invalid_tax_rate: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with up to two decimals.
errors.invalid_fee: Enter a whole amount from 0 to 1,000,000 SDG.
errors.invalid_registration: Enter the vehicle's registration number (up to 30 characters).
errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number: 7 to 15 digits, optionally starting with +.
errors.phone_taken: You already have a driver with this phone number.
errors.driver_not_found: This driver could not be found.
errors.driver_in_use: This driver is on a draft trip. Change the trip's driver or delete the trip first.
errors.invalid_trailer: Enter valid trailer plates (up to 3), each different from the vehicle's own plate.
errors.invalid_party: Check the sender and receiver: names up to 120 characters, addresses up to 200, and valid phone numbers.
errors.incomplete_manifest: The manifest isn't complete yet. Fill in the missing details before generating the bill ID.
errors.invalid_document: Choose a PDF, JPG or PNG file for one of this trip's document types.
errors.document_too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.scan_conflict: This document doesn't match the shipment read from the trip's other documents (a certificate of origin is only for imports, an authorization only for imports and exports). Check the file, or remove the other documents and scan again.
errors.zero_bill: This trip's taxes and fees come to 0 SDG, so there is no bill to pay. The tax rates and fees need to be reviewed by the tax administration before this trip can be authorized.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.subtitle: The drivers who drive your vehicles. Each trip names one, and their name and phone are printed on its manifest.

empty.title: No drivers yet
empty.body: Add your drivers so you can pick one when you register a trip.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this driver?
deleteDialog.body: The driver will be removed from your list. Manifests already issued keep their name and phone.

trips.title: Trips
trips.subtitle: Register trips and see the transport tax due on each one.
trips.created: Trip for {{plate}} saved as a draft. Amount due: {{amount}}.

empty.title: No trips yet
empty.body: Create a trip to calculate its transport tax.

noVehicles.title: Add a vehicle first
noVehicles.body: Every trip is made by one of your registered vehicles.

form.title: New trip
form.subtitle: Enter the trip details. The trip cost and taxes are calculated as you go.
form.editSubtitle: Drafts can be changed until their bill ID is generated.

tax.title: Trip cost, taxes and fees
tax.distanceNote: Distance is estimated from city coordinates (straight line × {{factor}} road factor). Trip cost = rate × distance × quantity; the taxes are percentages of it, and the fees are fixed amounts.

items.title: Cargo items
items.name: Description
items.chooseVehicle: Select a vehicle first. Its capacity limits what it can carry.
items.none: No cargo items were recorded for this trip.

deleteDialog.title: Delete trip #{{id}}?
deleteDialog.body: This draft and its cargo items will be deleted. This can't be undone.

documents.hint: Attach the shipment's documents (PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 20 MB). Scan reads a document and fills in the form for you; you can always type the details instead. Scanning is simulated in this demo.
documents.review: Details read from your documents are highlighted. Check them before saving.
documents.title: Documents

draft.body: Generate an E-Sali bill ID to pay this trip's taxes and fees. They're calculated at the current rates and fees when the bill is issued.
draft.govtBody: No bill has been generated for this trip yet.

missing.title: Complete the manifest before generating the bill ID:
missing.packing: Packing type and number of packages for every item

pending.label: E-Sali bill ID
pending.hint: Pay this bill ID from any mobile banking app (Bankak or another bank), then refresh to confirm the payment.
pending.notPaid: Not paid yet. The trip stays pending until the payment is confirmed.

paid.title: Tax paid
paid.body: E-Sali confirmed the payment. The electronic payment receipt and the authorized manifest have been issued.

header.ministry: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning
header.title: Electronic Payment Receipt

certificate.footer: This receipt was issued electronically by the Masarat system and needs no signature or stamp.

manifest.title: Land Goods Movement Permit
manifest.name: Name
manifest.footer: Issued electronically by the Masarat system after the fees were paid with receipt {{receiptNo}}. Valid only with that receipt.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.scope: Tax collection across all fleet owners
dashboard.subtitle: All fleet owners · Updated {{time}}
dashboard.empty: No data for this period yet.

kpis.collectionRateHint: Paid share of the amount billed in the period

regenerate.title: Regenerate demo data?
regenerate.body: This deletes the demo fleet companies and all their vehicles, trips, bills, receipts and manifests, then creates them again with fresh dates. Anything added by hand to a demo company is deleted too; other companies' data is kept. Anyone signed in as a demo company is signed out.

taxes.title: Taxes and fees
taxes.subtitle: The taxes charged on each trip, as a percentage of its trip cost, and the fixed fees added to every bill.
taxes.feeHint: A fixed amount added to every bill. It isn't taxed.
taxes.example: On a trip cost of {{cost}}, the fleet owner pays {{amount}} in taxes and fees.
taxes.appliesTo: New rates apply to bills issued from now on. Bills already issued keep the rates they were issued with.

search.label: Search trips
search.placeholder: Search by E-Sali bill ID, MNF-/MSR- number, trip #, plate, company or city
search.manyResults: Showing the latest {{count}} trips. Narrow the search to see others.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: The dashboard as a PDF report, or the raw data as Excel or CSV. Exports are in Arabic.
export.reportNote: The report opens as a preview with the official letterhead; download it from there as a PDF.
export.dataNote: Excel writes one sheet per dataset; CSV is UTF-8 and opens in Excel.
export.csvFolder: CSV with several datasets: choose a folder, and each dataset is saved as its own file.

report.title: Road Transport Tax Collection Report
report.footer: Prepared by the Masarat system from the records available when it was issued.
